en: Colorized historic view of a European city square lined with ornate late-19th/early-20th-century buildings. A broad street runs through the center with pedestrians and early vehicles. To the right stands a tall baroque-style church or tower with an onion-shaped spire. Trees and a small park-like area appear in the foreground. The caption at the top reads 'Graz. Bismarkplatz.' and a printer's imprint is faintly visible in the upper right corner.
